_: Notice types the mini feed is allowed to raise. No ERROR may appear here -
an error fails the build whatever this file says. Each entry needs a reason,
and an entry that stops occurring has to be removed.

reasons.unexpected_enum_value: route_type 714, rail replacement bus, from the extended route types the validator does not know
reasons.route_short_name_too_long: route_short_name is an internal key, AW:POR->QBM:714, and should not be. Not yet ticketed
reasons.mixed_case_recommended_field: MSN station names are upper case. Fixed by D3/D5 supplying rider-facing names
reasons.transfer_distance_too_large: B2 moved the fixed links into transfers.txt; a tube leg really is 36 km
reasons.missing_bike_allowance: bikes_allowed is 0, meaning no information. D10 supplies it
reasons.missing_feed_contact_email_and_url: no contact address to publish yet
reasons.big_gap_in_service: the fixture is a slice of a refresh, so its services are sparse
reasons.service_extends_far_in_the_future: a calendar running to 2099 in the source
reasons.service_window_outside_feed_period: same calendars, against the three month build window
reasons.unknown_column: the twelve producer extension columns B2 added to transfers.txt, which the spec permits and the validator does not know
reasons.stop_without_stop_time: stations with no service inside the window, which are still real stations
